headlines.title: BlackRock® Canada Announces Final July Cash Distributions for the iShares® Premium Money Market ETF
headlines.summary: TORONTO, July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited (“BlackRock Canada”), an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE: BLK), today announced the final July 2026 cash distributions for the iShares Premium Money Market ETF.
